operations.label: x230-fresh-owner-preflight
argv:
python3 -B -c 'import json,os,platform,pwd,sys
from pathlib import Path
c=json.loads(sys.argv[1]);b=Path(c["base"]);s=Path(c["stage"]);p=Path(c["capsule"])
assert platform.node()=="qian-ThinkPad-X230" and platform.system()=="Linux" and platform.machine()=="x86_64"
assert os.geteuid()==1000 and pwd.getpwuid(os.geteuid()).pw_dir=="/home/qian"
assert b.resolve()==b and not os.path.lexists(s) and not os.path.lexists(p)
assert (b/"source-9770").is_dir() and (b/"source-9770-manifest.json").is_file()
v=os.statvfs(b);assert v.f_bavail*v.f_frsize>2400000000
s.mkdir(mode=0o700)
print(json.dumps(dict(hostname=platform.node(),uid=os.geteuid(),available_bytes=v.f_bavail*v.f_frsize,controller=str(s),capsule_absent=True)))

operations.label: x230-executor-launch-once
argv:
python3 -B -c 'import datetime,hashlib,json,os,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
os.umask(0o077)
cfg=json.loads(sys.argv[1]);stage=Path(cfg["stage"]);base=Path(cfg["base"]);capsule=Path(cfg["capsule"])
script=stage/"native_linux_artifact_run.py"
assert hashlib.sha256(script.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==cfg["script_sha"]
assert hashlib.sha256((capsule/"capsule.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest()==cfg["capsule_sha"]
args=[sys.executable,"-B",str(script),"execute","--source",str(base/"source-9770"),"--manifest",str(base/"source-9770-manifest.json"),"--source-commit","9770bdd4ca77aa832ec8083a054760637e92cfa1","--source-tree","f32f1acf9a794844719b6df225df3d23f2389e02","--producer-runner-sha256","587eb864f424b236fbc98e41fbc26c5e6c8713ded2e3dee0f2230df7447f66dd","--capsule",str(capsule),"--capsule-sha256",cfg["capsule_sha"],"--expected-executor-hostname","qian-ThinkPad-X230","--output",str(base/"native-artifact55-9770-x230-actual-20261019-r1")]
journal=dict(schema="heptabao.x230-artifact-executor-once.v2",status="intent_saved",started_utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),argv=args,submission_count=0,automatic_retry=False,compiled_on_executor=False)
def save():
 with (stage/"launch.json").open("w") as f:json.dump(journal,f,indent=2);f.write(chr(10));f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
assert not (stage/"launch.json").exists();save()
with (stage/"stdout.log").open("xb") as so,(stage/"stderr.log").open("xb") as se:
 p=subprocess.Popen(args,cwd=base/"source-9770",stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=so,stderr=se,start_new_session=True)
journal.update(status="running",submission_count=1,executor_pid=p.pid,executor_pgid=os.getpgid(p.pid));save()
print(json.dumps(dict(status="running",executor_pid=p.pid,launch=str(stage/"launch.json"),compiled_on_executor=False)),flush=True)
' '{"stage": "/home/qian/heptabao-continuation-20261019/native-artifact55-9770-executor-20261019-r1-controller", "base": "/home/qian/heptabao-continuation-20261019", "capsule": "/home/qian/heptabao-continuation-20261019/native-artifact55-9770-main-capsule-20261019-r1", "script_sha": "45a898ca7f902b4f179ea7035bd17b77fa41e34a9844470597d84bdcd63cf634", "capsule_sha": "a3e4f854fc643384381942eadaddaefa6e6e4f4cfc876ee6442f7b9f16df67d8"}'
